fit_reason: Whole 14ft aluminum fishing boat with outboard and trailer, listed by a private owner.
findings: White painted hull sides look dull and faded in the first photo
Interior floor near the stern shows dirt, stains and peeling paint
Cluttered interior with gas can, tackle box, loose seats and spare tire piled in the middle
Outboard lower unit and midsection look grimy and dull
Wooden bench seats look weathered and grey
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 14ft StarCraft. A cleanup of the interior floor near the stern and a wash and wax on the white hull sides would help it show better in photos. We do pre-sale boat details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
